acceptance.given: Stable and Candidate subjects are prepared for Matrix Case execution with their distinct fixtures and state.

oracle.expected: Each execution's evidence identifies both its Matrix Case and the executed subject.
forbidden: Execution evidence cannot be attributed to its Matrix Case or subject.
oracle.observable: The S2 selector's emitted execution-evidence records and assertions.

acceptance.then: Attributable evidence exists for all Matrix Case executions.
acceptance.when: Stable and Candidate subjects execute through the planned S2 Toolchain behavior test.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The S2 runtime behavior test must fail while emitted Matrix Case evidence omits its Matrix Case or executed-subject attribution.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record Matrix Case and executed-subject attribution on evidence emitted for immutable Stable and Candidate executions with distinct fixtures and state.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting removes the Toolchain evidence-attribution behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix Case executions without specified attribution transition to evidence records attributable to their Matrix Case and executed subject.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S2 test observes evidence for each exercised Matrix Case execution that identifies its Matrix Case and executed subject.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded and its snapshot has not yet been independently verified.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result records independent verification of its snapshot.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result without independent snapshot verification.
oracle.observable: The S7 selector's Replay Result record and assertion of independent snapshot verification.

acceptance.when: The planned S7 behavior test processes a successful Replay Result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The S7 runtime behavior test must fail while a successful Replay Result lacks recorded independent snapshot verification.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Independently verify and record the snapshot binding for every successful Replay Result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores prior replay snapshot-verification behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A successful Replay Result lacking independently established snapshot verification transitions to a result with recorded independent snapshot verification.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 test observes independent snapshot verification recorded on the successful Replay Result.

acceptance.given: A Candidate Route was enabled for each Consumer in the frozen, complete Consumer Manifest; each applicable fixture has a bound Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category; no approved, bound applicability exception exists.

oracle.expected: For every applicable Consumer and fixture, the disable receipt records an actual Prior Route invocation and matches the bound Prior Route identity, baseline verdict, and diagnostic category.
forbidden: A missing Consumer or applicable fixture receipt.
A Candidate Route invocation during disable.
Any identity, verdict, or diagnostic-category mismatch from the Prior Behavior Baseline.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer, per-fixture disable receipts emitted by the Toolchain replay entrypoint.

acceptance.then: Every applicable Consumer completes disable through the Prior Route with reproduced baseline identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.
acceptance.when: A disable transition is executed through each applicable real Consumer.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the disable-transition test with a Consumer adapter that changes route configuration without invoking the bound Prior Route; observe the required failing assertion before implementation.
Supply a disable receipt whose Prior Route identity, verdict, or diagnostic category differs from its bound baseline and require rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the Toolchain replay entrypoint so disable invokes the Prior Route through every applicable real Consumer and emits per-Consumer, per-fixture receipts bound to the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category; reject configuration-only disable and any missing or mismatched reproduction.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Disable receipts are additive Toolchain evidence; rollback restores the prior replay-entrypoint behavior while preserving failed receipts and does not alter Phase, runtime, or Hosted state.

slice_hint.state_transition: Candidate Route enabled -> disable invokes Prior Route through every applicable Consumer -> per-fixture baseline reproduction recorded.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The disable transition succeeds only when every applicable Consumer receipt proves a real Prior Route invocation and exact reproduction of the bound Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.

acceptance.given: The six closed Matrix Cases and their frozen Stable and Candidate identities are available to the Toolchain execution path.

oracle.expected: For each materially distinct case, the execution record binds immutable Stable and Candidate identities, distinct fixture or state context, and attributable observations from both subject runs.
forbidden: A Matrix Case omits either subject execution.
A Stable or Candidate identity changes during execution.
A case substitutes shared, copied, or merely relabelled state for its distinct two-sided execution.
oracle.observable: The matrix aggregate produced by the Toolchain shows two immutable subject executions with distinct fixture or state context and attributable evidence for all six Matrix Cases.

acceptance.then: All six materially distinct Matrix Cases have executed both immutable subjects with distinct fixtures or state and attributable evidence.
acceptance.when: When the matrix execution selector runs the six closed cases.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the authored S2 matrix test with one subject execution or required distinct state intentionally absent, and observe aggregate failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain matrix path require and attribute both immutable subjects with distinct fixture or state context for every one of the six closed Matrix Cases.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore the prior Toolchain matrix behavior without altering frozen Matrix Case identities, historical evidence, or the closed six-case contract.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix case without verified two-sided immutable execution -> matrix case with attributable Stable and Candidate executions using distinct state or fixtures.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The authored selector verifies both immutable subject executions, distinct fixture or state context, and attributable observations for each of the six Matrix Cases.
